title: Swampy Mod
description: Adds four custom music discs, unique crafting rituals, chest loot, and a fully themed Swampy server menu to enhance your world’s atmosphere.
body:
🎶 Swampy Music Discs
Swampy Music Discs is a lightweight Fabric mod that adds four custom music discs to Minecraft, each with its own sound, crafting ritual, and acquisition method. Designed for lore-driven servers and chaotic fun, this mod enhances your world’s atmosphere with swamp magic, dwarven chants, and lava-chicken energy.

🪶 Features
4 custom music discs:

Swampy — crafted with mud and slime block

Miner’s Hole — found in loot chests

Diggy Diggy Hole — crafted with stone and gold block

Lava Chicken — crafted with lava bucket and raw chicken

Custom sound events for each disc

Unique crafting recipes and loot table injection

Jukebox compatibility via proper music disc tagging

Swampy-themed server menu branding for immersive identity

Fabric loader support, built for Minecraft 1.20.1+

🧪 Compatibility
Works on both client and server

Fully compatible with Fabric-based modpacks

No dependencies beyond Fabric API

🛠️ Installation
Install Fabric Loader and Fabric API

Drop the mod JAR into your mods folder

Launch Minecraft and enjoy the swampy soundtrack
